privacy.level.baseline.name: Baseline
privacy.level.baseline.description: Default posture. If enabled, recents are stored in plaintext. Third-party geocoding is allowed and error reporting is on. Fastest and most convenient.
privacy.level.standard.name: Standard
privacy.level.standard.description: If enabled, recents are encrypted and the remembered map area is snapped to a stop centroid. Shared coordinates are rounded. Recommended default for most users.
privacy.level.hardened.name: Hardened
privacy.level.hardened.description: No third-party geocoding. Saves always encrypted. Map taps rounded to a 50 m grid. URL share omits coordinates. Error reporting off.
privacy.level.strict.name: Strict
privacy.level.strict.description: Self-hosted geocoding disabled. 100 m coarsening floor. If enabled, recents are purged after 7 days. Real-time polling only in the foreground.
privacy.level.paranoid.name: Paranoid
privacy.level.paranoid.description: If enabled, recents stay in RAM only. Saves can never be exported or shared. Reverse geocoding for map taps is disabled. Real-time polling disabled — schedule-only.

privacy.disclosure.atRest: Recent locations, saved places, and preferences can be stored in this browser according to your settings. PTN also requests public transit data from its operator; enabled map, search, and routing providers receive only the fields listed in their disclosures.
privacy.disclosure.installKey: Encrypted recents and saves are sealed with a per-install key generated on this browser profile. The key is non-extractable, never leaves this device, and is not synced or backed up anywhere — every browser, profile, and device holds a separate install. Clearing site data, switching browsers, or losing the device destroys the key and makes any encrypted records unreadable. If your browser cannot generate or persist the key, the app falls back gracefully and shows a warning at Hardened and above.
privacy.installKey.degradedWarning: Encryption unavailable — privacy level fallback applied.
privacy.level.downgradeWarning: Lowering your privacy level can re-expose previously protected data on this device. Continue?
privacy.disclosure.mapTap: When you tap the map to set an origin or destination, the coordinate saved into recents is snapped or rounded according to your privacy preset. Exact taps are never persisted at Hardened or above.
privacy.disclosure.urlShare: Shareable URLs can carry coordinates, stop IDs, or nothing at all. At Hardened and above, coordinates are stripped and the URL references stop IDs only.
privacy.disclosure.providerFallback: Geocoder providers are tried in order of privacy tier (local, then self-hosted, then third-party). Fallbacks never happen silently at Standard or above — a status indicator shows which provider answered.
privacy.disclosure.transitousProvider: Trip start, destination, and departure time are sent through the PTN operator to transitous, a third-party routing service. Shared fields: {fields}.
privacy.disclosure.errorReporting: If enabled, internal error reports are buffered locally for possible later delivery to help fix bugs. At Hardened and above, error reporting is disabled and the buffer is never written.
privacy.disclosure.realTimePolling: Real-time departure polling has distinct cadences (idle / navigating / transfer). Adaptive mode adds jitter to obscure phase transitions. At Strict the app only polls when visible; at Paranoid polling is disabled entirely.
privacy.disclosure.bundledGeocoder: Place search uses a bundled dataset of landmarks and points of interest (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). The dataset is embedded in the app image — no search queries or city selections are sent over the network. Self-hosters control which cities are included by rebuilding the image.
privacy.thirdParty.lockedCopy: Third-party geocoding is disabled at this privacy level. Lower your level to Standard or below to configure providers.
privacy.disclosure.thirdParty: Enabling this sends coordinates (grid-snapped to {gridMeters}m) to {provider}. Network address, timing, and browser fingerprint are NOT mitigated. Use Tor Browser or a VPN for that tier.
privacy.disclosure.m10DedupCache: Dedup cache reduces third-party calls but creates a write-once query log on device. The log is unconditionally encrypted via the install key and expires per your privacy level (30d Baseline, 7d Standard, 1d Hardened when third-party is re-enabled). Strict and Paranoid do not cache. Browser profile reset destroys it with the install key.
privacy.disclosure.m11Tiles: Panning the map fetches area-of-interest tiles from the PTN backend. Each tile names a ~12 km grid cell and is guaranteed to contain at least 50 places (build-time check). Single tiles reveal a coarse area; a long sequence of tiles from the same IP reveals pan patterns at that granularity. Your privacy preset picks a defense: Baseline loads on demand (no extra traffic); Standard prefetches the whole city once (~70–110 kB per city, zero runtime requests after that); Hardened adds 2 decoy tiles alongside each real fetch; Strict does the same; Paranoid also fires a decoy tile every 2–5 minutes while the app is visible. None of these defenses fully defeat an operator who logs tile requests over time — use Tor or a VPN if you need network-layer unlinkability.
privacy.optional.heading: Optional local memory
privacy.optional.intro: PTN works without these. If you enable one, its data stays in this browser and you can stop and delete it at any time.
privacy.optional.recents_desc: Keep origins and destinations for quicker searches. Your privacy level controls encryption and retention.
privacy.optional.recents_prompt_desc: This can make repeat trips quicker. PTN works normally if you say no, and the choice applies only to this browser.
privacy.optional.viewport_desc: Reopen the map near where you left it. PTN stores only the precision your privacy level permits.
privacy.optional.personalization_desc: Use recent stop taps to rank likely stops on this device. Counts expire after 30 or 7 days; stricter levels turn this off.
privacy.optional.withdrawn_status: Remembering stopped and existing data was deleted.
privacy.optional.withdraw_error: Remembering is off, but some existing data could not be deleted. Try again.
privacy.optional.state_unavailable: Unavailable at your current privacy level
privacy.deletion.heading: Delete data
privacy.deletion.history_desc: Removes recent and saved places, journeys, local reports, stop-use counts, and the remembered map area.
privacy.deletion.history_confirm: Delete recent places, saved places and journeys, stop-use counts, local delay reports, and the last map area? Downloaded transit data and settings will stay.
privacy.deletion.downloads_desc: Removes reproducible schedules, stops, place indexes, and PTN/CARTO caches. Your own data stays.
privacy.deletion.downloads_confirm: Clear downloaded transit schedules, stops, place data, and PTN/CARTO map caches? PTN will download them again when needed. Personal history and settings will stay.
privacy.deletion.reset_desc: Removes everything owned by PTN in this browser, then reloads. Unrelated website storage and caches stay.
privacy.deletion.reset_confirm: Remove all PTN data, settings, choices, downloads, and PTN-owned caches from this browser? This cannot be undone. Other websites' data will not be touched.
privacy.deletion.error: Some PTN data could not be cleared. Nothing outside PTN was touched; please try again.

privacy.carriedOver.description: These protections were part of your privacy level before this update. They stay until you remove them or choose a level below Strict.
